title: KU Leuven Scholarship for Africa
field: Master's programmes (eligible list published by KU Leuven)
about: KU Leuven invites applicants from eligible African countries to apply for the KU Leuven Scholarship for Africa for an eligible master's programme starting in 2027-2028. The scholarship application has two steps: the programme application and online candidacy registration.
requirements: Complete application for an eligible KU Leuven master's programme
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for KU Leuven Scholarship for Africa at KU Leuven, Leuven, Belgium, deadline 15 Jan 2027. The background photo shows the steel spheres of the Atomium in Brussels against a cloudy sky.
